userStories.title: Metadata preparation (apply changes to copy)
userStories.description: Implement prepare_metadata() — applies desired changes to a copy of source metadata based on MetadataOp. Handles Set (with REMOVE_TAG), Append, AppendList, Insert (with deduplication), Remove (with semicolon subject handling).
acceptanceCriteria: Set: replaces existing, adds new, REMOVE_TAG deletes, multiple fields
Append: concatenates strings with space, errors on arrays, sets missing fields
AppendList: appends to array, converts string to array, creates list from missing, allows dupes
Insert: at index 0 (prepend), deduplication, converts string to list
Remove: from array, last-from-array deletes field, scalar match deletes, semicolon subjects
All unit tests pass (see implementation plan Task 6 for full test list)
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005. This is the core logic — test thoroughly

userStories.title: JSON Patch computation with expect test ops
userStories.description: Implement compute_patch() — uses json_patch::diff() to compute RFC 6902 patch from source vs destination, prepends test ops from --expect for optimistic concurrency.
acceptanceCriteria: With expect: test ops prepended before patch ops
Indexed expect keys produce correct path (e.g., /field/0)
